title: Normalized constant-unit Frobenius coherence
statement: Let D be a finite-field datum, l a prime distinct from D.p, and \Omega an algebraic closure of Q_l. For any finite-type arithmetic models X_0,Y_0 and morphism f_0:X_0\to Y_0, put f=zlFiberMap D f_0 and let u_f:Lf*\Lambda_Y\cong \Lambda_X be the rationalized normalized strict coefficient unit included at the least finite stage. Then t_f followed by Lf*(\theta_Y) followed by u_f equals Q_X(u_f) followed by \theta_X, where t_f is podCommonSquarePullbackComponent and \theta_X,\theta_Y are the specified constant Weil structures. This is independent of compactification, smoothness, dimension and purity. The constant Weil structures are those of [def-weil-constant-weil-structure], the normalized derived pullbacks are those of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and the semilinear square comparison is [lem-pod-semilinear-field-operation-lifts]. The geometric fiber map f is that of [def-weil-frobenius-witnessed-compactification], the geometric Frobenius naturality square is that of [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category], and the prime-invertibility instances and common-stage Frobenius pullbacks Q_X are those of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], in the common-stage categories of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. The unit u_f is built from the strict Roos unit on the integral operation complexes of [def-pur-integral-operation-complex-models] with the finite pullback generators of [def-pur-integral-finite-pullback] and the reduction tower of [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower], the good-representative comparison of [def-trf-integral-pullback-descent-model] on the completed coefficient object of [def-weil-constant-coefficient-objects], and the rational pullback of [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations].

proof.text: Apply rationalizedUnit_frobenius at the least finite coefficient field. The rationalUnit constructor agrees definitionally with rationalizedUnit, since both use the same uniquely normalized strict chain unit.

The common-stage map formula identifies pullback of each included rational arrow with the inclusion of its rational pullback. The common compositor normalization identifies the two composition components, including their inverses, with the included rational components; proof irrelevance transports the equality of scheme composites. The common units and constant Weil structures differ from the included rational maps only by the specified eqToIso source comparisons.

Apply the stage inclusion to the rational equation. Functor.map_comp and heterogeneous composition identify its sides with the required common-stage composites; equal endpoints turn heterogeneous equality into the asserted equality.

lean.statement:
theorem commonUnit_frobenius
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    (X₀ Y₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀)))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Y₀.hom]
    (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) :
    letI := fun x ↦ sfWeilPrimeInvertible D l hl X₀ x
    letI := fun y ↦ sfWeilPrimeInvertible D l hl Y₀ y
    let f := FrobeniusExchange.fiberMap D f₀
    let K := unit D l hl Ω (D.geometricFiber Y₀).left
    let u := commonUnit D l hl Ω f
    (podCommonSquarePullbackComponent l Ω f
        (D.geometricFrobenius X₀).hom (D.geometricFrobenius Y₀).hom
        (zlFrobenius_naturality D f₀) K).hom ≫
        (commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω f).map
          (constantWeilAlgebraicallyClosedComplex l D hl Y₀ Ω).str.hom ≫ u.hom =
      (sfCommonStageWeilFrobeniusPullback D l hl X₀ Ω).map u.hom ≫
        (constantWeilAlgebraicallyClosedComplex l D hl X₀ Ω).str.hom
